name: ticker-line
description: 横幅揭示：整行文字按 clip-path 从左擦出（发布通告/一句话主张）
css: #tpl-ticker-line { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2.6vh; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .tk-line { font-size: 6vh; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.18; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); transform-origin: left center; } .tk-sub { font-size: 2.3vh; opacity: .7; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); clip-path: inset(0% 100% 0% 0%); }
timeline: if (window.ScrambleTextPlugin) { tl.to("{tpl} .tk-line", { duration: 1.1, scrambleText: { text: {{text}}, chars: "零一二三四五六七八九十ABCDEF0123456789●", speed: 1.4 } }, {start} + 0.15);} else { tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tk-line", { clipPath: "inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.7, ease: "power3.inOut" }, {start} + 0.15);}tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tk-sub", { clipPath: "inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)" }, { clipPath: "inset(0% 0% 0% 0%)", duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.inOut" }, {start} + 1.0);
